typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	dBusinessDateRpt as timestamp (toTimestamp('4/26/2026')),
	dFileCreatedDate as timestamp (toTimestamp('8/11/2017 10:37:00 AM')),
	sFileName as string (),
	sFileSearchDate as string ('04262026'),
	toRTATempImport_outputfilename as string (),
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Business Date} as string,
		{User Name} as string,
		{Original Status} as string,
		{Action Status} as string,
		{End Status} as string,
		{Old Version} as string,
		{New Version} as string,
		{Internal Reference} as string,
		{Calypso Reference} as integer,
		{Book Name} as string,
		{Trade Status} as string,
		Trader as string,
		{Sales Person} as string,
		{Counterparty Name} as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{Field Amended} as string,
		Before as string,
		After as string,
		{Amendment P L} as string,
		{Amendment Cash} as string,
		{Column 19} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource	source(output(
		USER_NAME as string,
		MO_GROUP_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GetCLYUserName
FlatFileSource split(length(Business Date) == 0, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(InvalidRow,ValidRow)
GetCLYUserName derive(oUSER_NAME = USER_NAME,
		oMO_GROUP_NAME = MO_GROUP_NAME) ~> ConvertUsername
ConvertUsername sort(asc(oUSER_NAME, false),asc(oMO_GROUP_NAME, false)) ~> Sort
ConditionalSplit@ValidRow derive(oBefore = Before,
		oAfter = After,
		oTrader = Trader) ~> DataConversionV2
ConditionalSplit@ValidRow aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversionV2 sort(asc({User Name}, false)) ~> Sortusername
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
Sortusername,Sort join({User Name} == oUSER_NAME,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin derive(Business_Date = Business_Date,
		User_Name = User_Name,
		Original_Status = Original_Status,
		Action_Status = Action_Status,
		End_Status = End_Status,
		Old_Version = Old_Version,
		New_Version = New_Version,
		Internal_Reference = Internal_Reference,
		Book_Name = Book_Name,
		Trade_Status = Trade_Status,
		Field_Amended = Field_Amended,
		oBefore = oBefore,
		oAfter = oAfter,
		oTrader = oTrader,
		{o Sales Person} = {o Sales Person},
		{oCounterparty Name} = {oCounterparty Name},
		{oAmendment P L} = {oAmendment P L},
		{oAmendment Cash} = {oAmendment Cash},
		{oProduct Type} = {oProduct Type},
		oMO_GROUP_NAME = oMO_GROUP_NAME,
		Calypso_Reference = Calypso_Reference) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 derive(MKey_BDteCRef = toString((Business_Date + '-' + toString(Calypso_Reference))),
		Date_Added = $startTime,
		Business_Date_Short = toString($sFileSearchDate),
		Business_Date_Rpt = $dBusinessDateRpt,
		FileFolder_Source = toString($sFileName),
		FileCreated_Date = $dFileCreatedDate,
		sMO_GroupName = toString((iif(isNull(oMO_GROUP_NAME), 'Other', oMO_GROUP_NAME)))) ~> CalculatedColumns
CalculatedColumns sink(input(
		Before as string,
		Date_Added as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Old_Version as string,
		Trade_Status as string,
		New_Version as string,
		Business_Date_Short as string,
		Amendment as string,
		Action_Status as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		Business_Date as string,
		End_Status as string,
		Business_Date_Rpt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Field_Amended as string,
		MO_AccessGroup as string,
		User_Name as string,
		Internal_Reference as string,
		Trader as string,
		Book_Name as string,
		MKey_BDteCRef as string,
		Sales_Person as string,
		File_Date_Created as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		After as string,
		FileFolder_Source as string,
		Calypso_Reference as integer,
		Original_Status as string,
		Amendment_Cash as string,
		Product_Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 1000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Before = oBefore,
		Date_Added,
		Old_Version,
		Trade_Status,
		New_Version,
		Business_Date_Short,
		Amendment = {oAmendment P L},
		Action_Status,
		Counterparty = {oCounterparty Name},
		Business_Date,
		End_Status,
		Business_Date_Rpt,
		Field_Amended,
		MO_AccessGroup = sMO_GroupName,
		User_Name,
		Internal_Reference,
		Trader = oTrader,
		Book_Name,
		MKey_BDteCRef,
		Sales_Person = {o Sales Person},
		File_Date_Created = FileCreated_Date,
		After = oAfter,
		FileFolder_Source,
		Calypso_Reference,
		Original_Status,
		Amendment_Cash = {oAmendment Cash},
		Product_Type = {oProduct Type}),
	partitionFileNames:[($toRTATempImport_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toRTATempImport
